entities.summary:
Valkeakoski is a town and municipality in Finland. It is located 35 kilometres (22 mi) south of Tampere, 45 km (28 mi) north of Hämeenlinna and 150 km (93 mi) north of Helsinki in the Pirkanmaa region. The municipality has a population of 20,778
(31 December 2025) and covers an area of 372.03 square kilometres (143.64 sq mi) of
which 100.06 km2 (38.63 sq mi)
is water. The population density is
76.38 inhabitants per square kilometre (197.8/sq mi). Valkeakoski is a town in Northern Europe, established around 1923. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 55 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
